title: ectl
description: Adds a very easy way to make a creative tab
body:
![ectl logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8c98084b88f849c8651f6977cd04ced591776a4d.png)

ectl is a beginner- and developer-friendly library mod for Fabric, designed to take the headache out of creating and managing Creative Inventory Tabs.
Instead of dealing with complex builders and nested code, ectl provides a streamlined way to register your custom tabs and organize your items with minimal effort.

---

### ✨ Features
**Simplified Registration:** Create custom Creative Tabs with just a few lines of code.

**Easy Item Management:** Effortlessly add items, blocks, and even custom stacks to your tabs.

**Split-Environment Support:** Works perfectly with Fabric's split client/server source sets.
